# Find the original image: reverse image search playbook

Curated by Skill Harbor — ⚠️ **Security warning / Avertissement de sécurité — AUTHORIZED USE ONLY / USAGE AUTORISÉ UNIQUEMENT** : this skill teaches reverse image search as an OSINT tradecraft — which engines to start with depending on what you're holding (Yandex for faces and non-Western scenes, Google Lens for products and OCR text, Bing Visual for region-crop retries, TinEye for oldest-first sorting of press photos, Baidu for China-hosted content), the high-yield crop-and-re-search method, flip-and-retry against mirrored reposts, keyframe extraction for video, and a confidence-grading ladder from "match only" up to "confirmed original source" — with worked examples, common failure modes (stock photos, AI-generated images with no origin to find, leaking client images to commercial engines), and pivots to sibling OSINT skills. **Kept by editorial choice as a borderline case: the guide itself frames authorized, legitimate use only** (scam and fake-profile investigation, disinformation and media verification, counterfeit and brand-infringement work, insurance claim review), and its face-search section carries explicit legal notes — facial templates are biometric data under GDPR Article 9, Illinois BIPA and Texas CUBI; PimEyes is positioned by its own terms for searching your own face — and draws a hard line at identifying strangers, protest crowds or private individuals. Defensive/legitimate use only. Honest caveats: MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review...
